create_APoTQuantizer: create an APoTQuantizer with alpha, gamma, quantization_levels, and level_indices tensors
quantize_tensor_APoT: quantize a float tensor to integer APoT representation using quantize_APoT
dequantize_tensor_APoT: dequantize an APoT tensor back to floating point representation
quant_dequant_tensor_APoT: run quantize then dequantize on a float tensor using quant_dequant_APoT
review_APoTQuantizer_methods: review the APoTQuantizer class quantize, dequantize, and quant_dequant methods
